Characters

Characters are saved in this browser and reload automatically. Filenames like Name_server-BRD-MissingSpells.txt pick their class from the -BRD- token; files without a token use the class selected next to the Load button.

Expansions

Data admin — import class spell lists / publish site
Workflow: on eqitems.com run the spell search for a class, save the page (Ctrl+S → HTML), name it after the class (e.g. Cleric.html), and import it here. Imported data lives in this browser until you click Download site — that produces a new single-file spell-tracker.html with all class data embedded; upload it to your host's tools/ folder.
